notes.title: An update regarding the update of game
notes.content:
Hi all, i have promised to bring the update of this game in 2 weeks. But that date is already passed. Along with listed bugs, i am working on new gameplay feature. I want to release it now with this update because you guys will play whole 3 levels this time as i am adding melee. 

There is no point to release a new feature update later on without more levels, because it's less interesting to play the whole beta version again only for that feature. Mostly one more week and it will ready and so the update will be live within a week to 10 days. Sorry for delay and thanks for understanding.

notes.title: New update coming soon!!
notes.content:
From our players review on the game, I am working on fixing the reported issues and within 2 weeks, a new update will be released. here are the following issues that will be fixed in coming update.

1) Option for remapping controls
2) adding sound effects 
3) fixing ads sight
4) health bar for enemies will be added
5) melee will be available
6) changing reload mechanism
7) minor bug fixes in level
